title: Democratic Policy Development using Collective Dialogues and AI
findings: The democratic process generated AI policy guidelines with strong, bridging support across religious divides. For the three policies developed (Medical advice, Wars and Conflicts, Vaccines), the lowest support from any measured religious subgroup (Christian, Non-christian religious, Non-religious) was 70%, indicating the process is effective at finding common ground and building consensus among people of different religious backgrounds.
